cards.card_text: The fire Nadab and Abihu offered before the LORD was what the LORD had commanded.
cards.verse_text: Now Aaron’s sons Nadab and Abihu took their censers, put fire in them and added incense, and offered unauthorized fire before the LORD, contrary to His command.
cards.snippet: …Abihu took their censers, put fire in them and added incense, and offered unauthorized fire before the LORD, contrary to His command.

cards.card_text: Aaron's sons were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, but Nadab and Abihu died when they offered unauthorized fire before the LORD.
cards.verse_text: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar were born to Aaron, but Nadab and Abihu died when they offered unauthorized fire before the LORD.
cards.snippet: …Ithamar were born to Aaron, but Nadab and Abihu died when they offered unauthorized fire before the LORD.

cards.card_text: True or false: in the morning, the men of the city find the second bull offered up on a newly built altar.
cards.verse_text: When the men of the city got up in the morning, there was Baal’s altar torn down, with the Asherah pole cut down beside it and the second bull offered up on the newly built altar.
cards.snippet: …with the Asherah pole cut down beside it and the second bull offered up on the newly built altar.

cards.card_text: Then once more, he asks for God's eyes to be open and His ears attentive to the prayer offered in this place.

cards.card_text: The LORD says from now on His eyes will be open and His ears attentive to the prayers offered in this place.
cards.verse_text: Now My eyes will be open and My ears attentive to the prayers offered in this place.
cards.snippet: …My eyes will be open and My ears attentive to the prayers offered in this place.

cards.card_text: Ezra is to take silver and gold the king and his counselors FREELY offered to the God of Israel, plus silver and gold from the province of Babylon and freewill offerings from the people and priests.

cards.card_text: Offered fragrant incense to their idols Hid from the armies of their enemies Built homes for their growing families
cards.verse_text: Then you will know that I am the LORD, when their slain lie among their idols around their altars, on every high hill, on all the mountaintops, and under every green tree and leafy oak—the places where they offered fragrant incense to all their idols.

cards.card_text: Israel defiled His temple when they offered His food, the fat and the blood, and they broke His covenant.
cards.verse_text: In addition to all your other abominations, you brought in foreigners uncircumcised in both heart and flesh to occupy My sanctuary; you defiled My temple when you offered My food—the fat and the blood; you broke My covenant.
cards.snippet: …and flesh to occupy My sanctuary; you defiled My temple when you offered My food—the fat and the blood; you broke My covenant.

cards.card_text: The man tells him these are the kitchens where those who minister at the temple will cook the sacrifices offered by the people.
cards.verse_text: And he said to me, “These are the kitchens where those who minister at the temple will cook the sacrifices offered by the people.”
cards.snippet: …kitchens where those who minister at the temple will cook the sacrifices offered by the people.”

cards.card_text: Once they're welcomed into a house, Jesus says eat and drink whatever they're offered, for the worker is worthy of his wages.
cards.verse_text: Stay at the same house, eating and drinking whatever you are offered.
cards.snippet: Stay at the same house, eating and drinking whatever you are offered.

cards.card_text: Paul says the sacrifices of pagans are offered to ___, not to God.
cards.verse_text: No, but the sacrifices of pagans are offered to demons, not to God.
cards.snippet: No, but the sacrifices of pagans are offered to demons, not to God.
